digest.greeting: Good evening, Jean. Today’s evidence shows concrete movement on the Mental Health communication gap, while Amazon Connect and Salesforce issues remain the main follow-through areas. Wednesday is meeting-heavy, with two calendar overlaps to resolve.

items.label: Closed the immediate Mental Health communication gap
items.detail: Jean scheduled an alignment with Shelley and Mar, and told Mar to include Shelley in future MHE RFE/Expansion meetings.

items.label: Resolve the remaining Amazon Connect questions and go/no-go path

items.label: Prepare the critical-project updates for Thursday’s ELT discussion
items.detail: Sara asked the team to provide deeper updates on selected critical projects for the Thursday 9:00 AM meeting. Confirm the project status, risks, and decision asks that Jean will bring forward.

items.label: Align on the compressed Pre-Intake Sales Cloud timeline
items.detail: The proposed plan preserves the go-live window but compresses development, QA, focused UAT, training, and cutover work. Confirm the additional testers, training approach, and acceptance of the delivery risk.

items.label: Track the Revenue Cloud licensing blocker
items.detail: Salesforce is reviewing missing Revenue Cloud User licensing under case 474580932. The gap may delay Pay Now functionality and its demo, with no confirmed correction date yet.

items.label: Review the KCI window concerns from testing
items.detail: Testing identified workflow, accuracy, and rework risks with the smaller KCI window. Decide whether to retain the full-size view or pursue an alternative that preserves usable workspace.

items.label: Confirm whether the BD Bonus Comp Compliance project can close
items.detail: Jean asked Sara whether the project is still needed after Matthew said the new bonus structure had already rolled out. The closure decision is still awaiting confirmation.

items.label: Clear the overdue Rippling task
items.detail: Rippling reported one overdue task for Jean today. Review the outstanding item and complete or reassign it as appropriate.
